topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't stop thinking about when I was in your class, and all the times I felt like I was barely floating but you threw me a lifeline. I remember the way you’d always check in, asking if I was okay, if I needed help. It wasn’t just the grades; it was the way you cared about what happened to me after the bell rang. I wish I’d told you more then, how much your words meant, how they kept me going. Seeing you again today, I just wanted you to know that. I didn’t know what else to do, so I brought something small, hoping it’d show a little of what’s been in my heart all these years. I hope it’s okay.
